source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ מָק֣וֹר נִפְתָּ֔ח לְבֵ֥ית דָּוִ֖יד וּלְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְחַטַּ֖את וּלְנִדָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day there will be a fountain opened for [the] house of David and for [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for impurity.

en.L: In that day there will be a fountain opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for impurity.
en.B: On that day a fountain will be opened for the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to wash away their sin and impurity.
en.R: At that time a spring will be opened for the family of David and the people of Jerusalem. Its water will wash away their sin and make them clean.

es.L: En aquel día habrá un manantial abierto para la casa de David y para los habitantes de Jerusalén, para el pecado y para la impureza.
es.B: Aquel día se abrirá un manantial para la casa de David y para los habitantes de Jerusalén, para lavar su pecado y su impureza.
es.R: En ese tiempo se abrirá un manantial para la familia de David y para la gente de Jerusalén. Su agua lavará su pecado y los dejará limpios.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, il y aura une source ouverte pour la maison de David et pour les habitants de Jérusalem, pour le péché et pour l’impureté.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, une source sera ouverte pour la maison de David et pour les habitants de Jérusalem, afin de laver leur péché et leur impureté.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, une source sera ouverte pour la famille de David et pour les habitants de Jérusalem. Son eau lavera leur péché et les rendra purs.

sw.L: Katika siku ile kutakuwa na chemchemi iliyofunguliwa kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Daudi na kwa ajili ya wakaaji wa Yerusalemu, kwa ajili ya dhambi na kwa ajili ya unajisi.
sw.B: Siku hiyo chemchemi itafunguliwa kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu, ili kuwaosha dhambi yao na unajisi wao.
sw.R: Wakati huo chemchemi itafunguliwa kwa ajili ya jamaa ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu. Maji yake yatawaosha dhambi yao na kuwafanya safi.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, sẽ có một suối nước mở ra cho nhà Đa-vít và cho dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì tội lỗi và vì sự ô uế.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, một suối nước sẽ mở ra cho nhà Đa-vít và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem, để rửa sạch tội lỗi và sự ô uế của họ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, một dòng suối sẽ được mở ra cho gia đình Đa-vít và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem. Nước suối ấy sẽ rửa sạch tội lỗi họ và làm cho họ được tinh sạch.

ko.L: 그날에 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들을 위하여 죄와 부정을 [씻는] 샘이 열릴 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들을 위하여 샘 하나가 열려, 그들의 죄와 부정을 씻어 줄 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 다윗의 집안과 예루살렘 사람들을 위하여 샘 하나가 열릴 것이다. 그 샘물이 그들의 죄를 씻어 주고 그들을 깨끗하게 해 줄 것이다.

decisions.choice: a fountain for sin and for impurity: water that cleanses
decisions.reason: The law used water to cleanse from uncleanness: "water for impurity", mixed with the ashes of a red heifer, cleansed those who had touched a dead body (Numbers 19:9-21). The word for "impurity" is the one used there; it also means the uncleanness of a woman's monthly period (Leviticus 15:19-24) and, in the prophets, the uncleanness of sin and idol worship (Ezekiel 36:17). Here God opens a spring that never runs dry, for cleansing from sin itself.

decisions.choice: on that day ... a fountain opened: the people who mourned in 12:10-14 are cleansed
decisions.reason: The same house of David and people of Jerusalem who mourned for the one they pierced (12:10) are now given cleansing. Ezekiel 36:25 promises, "I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean", and the picture of water flowing from Jerusalem returns in 14:8 (compare Ezekiel 47:1-12; Joel 4:18).

decisions.choice: to wash away (B); Its water will wash away ... make them clean (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "for sin and for impurity". Balanced and Readable say what the fountain is for (m1).

decisions.choice: "un manantial"
decisions.reason: The fountain is a spring of water that cleanses; Spanish "manantial" is used at every level.

source.text: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם׀יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת־שְׁמ֤וֹת הָֽעֲצַבִּים֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ע֑וֹד וְגַ֧ם אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־ר֥וּחַ הַטֻּמְאָ֖ה אַעֲבִ֥יר מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, [that] I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, and they will not be remembered again; and also the prophets and the spirit of the uncleanness I will cause to pass from the land.

en.L: And it will be in that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, [that] I will cut off the idols' names from the land, and they will not be remembered again; and also the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness I will remove from the land.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, I will wipe out the names of the idols from the land, and no one will remember them any more. The prophets too, and the spirit of impurity, I will remove from the land.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, I will get rid of the idols in the land, and no one will even remember their names. I will also remove the false prophets from the land, and the spirit that makes people unclean.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, [que] cortaré de la tierra los nombres de los ídolos, y no serán recordados más; y también a los profetas y al espíritu de impureza haré desaparecer de la tierra.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, borraré de la tierra los nombres de los ídolos, y nadie volverá a acordarse de ellos. También quitaré de la tierra a los profetas y al espíritu de impureza.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, acabaré con los ídolos del país, y nadie se acordará ni siquiera de sus nombres. También quitaré del país a los falsos profetas y al espíritu que hace impura a la gente.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, [que] je retrancherai du pays les noms des idoles, et on ne s’en souviendra plus ; et aussi les prophètes et l’esprit d’impureté, je les ferai disparaître du pays.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, j’effacerai du pays les noms des idoles, et personne ne s’en souviendra plus. Les prophètes aussi, et l’esprit d’impureté, je les ôterai du pays.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, je ferai disparaître les idoles du pays, et personne ne se souviendra même plus de leur nom. J’ôterai aussi du pays les faux prophètes, et l’esprit qui rend les gens impurs.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, [kwamba] nitayakatilia mbali majina ya sanamu kutoka nchi, wala hayatakumbukwa tena; na pia manabii na roho ya unajisi nitawaondoa kutoka nchi.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nitayafuta majina ya sanamu kutoka nchi, wala hakuna atakayeyakumbuka tena. Manabii pia, na roho ya unajisi, nitawaondoa kutoka nchi.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nitaziondoa sanamu katika nchi, wala hakuna atakayekumbuka hata majina yao. Nitawaondoa pia manabii wa uongo kutoka nchi, pamoja na roho inayowafanya watu kuwa najisi.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ tên của các thần tượng khỏi xứ, và chúng sẽ không còn được nhắc đến nữa; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ dẹp bỏ khỏi xứ các tiên tri và tà linh ô uế.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xóa sạch tên các thần tượng khỏi xứ, và không ai còn nhớ đến chúng nữa. Ta cũng sẽ dẹp bỏ khỏi xứ các tiên tri cùng tà linh ô uế.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ loại bỏ các thần tượng khỏi xứ, và không ai còn nhớ đến tên chúng nữa. Ta cũng sẽ dẹp bỏ khỏi xứ các tiên tri giả và tà linh làm cho người ta ô uế.

ko.L: 그날에, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다, 내가 그 땅에서 우상들의 이름을 끊어 버려, 다시는 그것들이 기억되지 않게 하겠다. 또 예언자들과 더러운 영도 그 땅에서 없애 버리겠다.
ko.B: 그날에 나는 그 땅에서 우상들의 이름을 지워 버려, 아무도 그것들을 다시는 기억하지 못하게 하겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 예언자들도, 더러운 영도 그 땅에서 없애 버리겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 그 땅에서 우상들을 없애 버려, 아무도 그 이름조차 기억하지 못하게 하겠다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 또 거짓 예언자들과 사람들을 더럽게 만드는 영도 그 땅에서 없애 버리겠다.

decisions.choice: cut off the names of the idols, and they will not be remembered: idol worship will end completely
decisions.reason: To call on a god's name was to worship it. Israel was told not even to mention the names of other gods (Exodus 23:13), and Hosea 2:19 promises that the names of the Baals will be forgotten. When the names are no longer spoken, the worship is gone.

decisions.choice: the prophets: those who prophesy falsely
decisions.reason: The prophets removed here are named with the idols and "the spirit of uncleanness", and verses 3-6 show that they speak lies in the LORD's name. They are false prophets, like those Jeremiah opposed (Jeremiah 23:9-40; 27:9-10). The Hebrew does not add "false"; the context makes it plain.

decisions.choice: the spirit of uncleanness: the power behind false prophecy and idol worship
decisions.reason: It stands against the "spirit of grace" the LORD pours out in 12:10. 1 Kings 22:22-23 tells of a "lying spirit" in the mouths of prophets. The LORD will remove the spirit that made his people unclean, as the fountain of verse 1 washes them.

decisions.choice: And it will be in that day, declares the LORD of hosts (L); On that day, declares the LORD of Armies (B); At that time, says the LORD of Armies (R); false prophets (R)
decisions.reason: The formulas follow the wording set in Isaiah. Readable adds "false" to make plain which prophets are meant (m2).

decisions.choice: "ídolos"
decisions.reason: The word here ('atsabbim) is the common word for idols, so it is plain "ídolos" at every level. R says "falsos profetas", as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "các tiên tri" (L, B) / "các tiên tri giả" (R), not "các nhà tiên tri"; "tà linh ô uế" for the spirit of uncleanness
decisions.reason: Plain "tiên tri" without the respectful "nhà" suits prophets the LORD removes; "tà linh" names an evil spirit, not God's Spirit.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־יִנָּבֵ֣א אִישׁ֮ עוֹד֒ וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵ֠לָיו אָבִ֨יו וְאִמּ֤וֹ יֹֽלְדָיו֙ לֹ֣א תִֽחְיֶ֔ה כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּדְקָרֻ֜הוּ אָבִ֧יהוּ וְאִמּ֛וֹ יֹלְדָ֖יו בְּהִנָּבְאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, if prophesies a man again, then will say to him his father and his mother who bore him, You will not live, for falsehood you have spoken in [the] name of Yahweh; and will pierce him his father and his mother who bore him when he prophesies.

en.L: And it will be, if anyone prophesies again, his father and his mother who bore him will say to him, "You shall not live, for you have spoken falsehood in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}"; then his father and his mother who bore him will pierce him through when he prophesies.
en.B: If anyone still prophesies, his own father and mother will say to him, "You must not live, because you have spoken lies in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." And when he prophesies, his own father and mother will run him through.
en.R: If anyone still claims to speak for God, his own parents will say to him, "You must die, because you have told lies and said they came from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." And when he prophesies, his own father and mother will stab him to death.

es.L: Y sucederá que, si alguno profetiza todavía, su padre y su madre que lo engendraron le dirán: «No vivirás, porque has hablado mentira en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}»; y su padre y su madre que lo engendraron lo traspasarán cuando profetice.
es.B: Si alguno sigue profetizando, su propio padre y su propia madre le dirán: «Tienes que morir, porque has dicho mentiras en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». Y cuando profetice, su propio padre y su propia madre lo traspasarán.
es.R: Si alguno sigue diciendo que habla de parte de Dios, sus propios padres le dirán: «Tienes que morir, porque has dicho mentiras y has dicho que venían {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». Y cuando profetice, su propio padre y su propia madre lo matarán a puñaladas.

fr.L: Et il arrivera que, si quelqu’un prophétise encore, son père et sa mère qui l’ont enfanté lui diront : « Tu ne vivras pas, car tu as dit le mensonge au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} » ; et son père et sa mère qui l’ont enfanté le transperceront quand il prophétisera.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un prophétise encore, son propre père et sa propre mère lui diront : « Tu dois mourir, car tu as dit des mensonges au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Et quand il prophétisera, son propre père et sa propre mère le transperceront.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un prétend encore parler de la part de Dieu, ses propres parents lui diront : « Tu dois mourir, parce que tu as dit des mensonges en prétendant qu’ils venaient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Et quand il prophétisera, son père et sa mère le poignarderont.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, mtu yeyote akitabiri tena, baba yake na mama yake waliomzaa watamwambia, "Hutaishi, kwa maana umesema uongo kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}"; ndipo baba yake na mama yake waliomzaa watamtoboa atakapotabiri.
sw.B: Ikiwa mtu yeyote bado atatabiri, baba yake na mama yake wenyewe watamwambia, "Hupaswi kuishi, kwa sababu umesema uongo kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Naye atakapotabiri, baba yake na mama yake wenyewe watamchoma kwa upanga.
sw.R: Ikiwa mtu yeyote bado atadai kwamba anasema kwa niaba ya Mungu, wazazi wake wenyewe watamwambia, "Lazima ufe, kwa sababu umesema uongo na kudai kwamba unatoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Naye atakapotabiri, baba yake na mama yake wenyewe watamchoma hadi afe.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, nếu có ai còn nói tiên tri, thì cha và mẹ đã sinh ra nó sẽ nói với nó: "Mày sẽ không được sống, vì mày đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nói điều giả dối"; rồi cha và mẹ đã sinh ra nó sẽ đâm nó khi nó nói tiên tri.
vi.B: Nếu có ai còn nói tiên tri, thì chính cha mẹ đã sinh ra nó sẽ bảo nó: "Con không được sống, vì con đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói dối." Và khi nó nói tiên tri, chính cha mẹ nó sẽ đâm nó.
vi.R: Nếu có ai còn tự xưng là nói thay cho Đức Chúa Trời, thì chính cha mẹ nó sẽ bảo nó: "Con phải chết, vì con đã nói dối mà bảo rằng đó là lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Và khi nó nói tiên tri, chính cha mẹ nó sẽ đâm chết nó.

ko.L: 누가 다시 예언하면, 그를 낳은 그의 아버지와 어머니가 그에게 "너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 거짓을 말하였으니 살지 못할 것이다" 하고 말할 것이다. 그리고 그가 예언할 때에 그를 낳은 그의 아버지와 어머니가 그를 찔러 죽일 것이다.
ko.B: 그래도 누가 예언을 하면, 그를 낳은 아버지와 어머니가 그에게 "너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 거짓말을 했으니 살아서는 안 된다" 하고 말할 것이다. 그리고 그가 예언할 때에 그를 낳은 아버지와 어머니가 그를 찔러 죽일 것이다.
ko.R: 그래도 누가 하나님의 말씀을 전한다고 하면, 그의 부모가 그에게 "너는 거짓말을 하고서 그것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀이라고 했으니 죽어야 한다" 하고 말할 것이다. 그리고 그가 예언할 때에 그의 부모가 그를 칼로 찔러 죽일 것이다.

decisions.choice: his father and his mother will say, You shall not live: the law on false prophets
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 13:7-12 and 18:20 say that a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, or claims to speak in the LORD's name what he has not commanded, must die, and that no one, not even a close relative, may shield him. Here the false prophet's own parents carry out the law. Their loyalty to the LORD will outweigh even their love for their son.

decisions.choice: pierce him through: the verb of 12:10
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 12:10, "the one they pierced". The parents run their son through with a sword or spear. The picture is extreme, and it shows how completely false prophecy will be rejected on that day.

decisions.choice: his own father and mother (B); his own parents (R); run him through (B); stab him to death (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "his own" to bring out the force of "who bore him", and leave out the repeated phrase the second time. Readable says "claims to speak for God" for "prophesies" at the start, and "You must die" for "You shall not live". The man is a son of his father and mother, so no gender setting is used.

decisions.choice: "lo traspasarán"
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of 12:10, so L and B keep "traspasar" there and here; R says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "le transperceront" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The same verb as 12:10 ("celui qu'ils ont transpercé"), which the meaning decision notes.

decisions.choice: "watamtoboa" (L), the verb of 12:10
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the same Swahili verb as 12:10 ("waliyemtoboa"), as the meaning decision notes the Hebrew repeats its verb.

decisions.choice: the parents say "mày" (L) / "con" (B, R) to the son
decisions.reason: L keeps the harshness of a death sentence; B and R keep the parent-child bond that makes the verse shocking.

decisions.choice: "찔러 죽이다"
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 12:10 (meaning decision); Korean keeps "찌르다" in both places.

decisions.choice: "đâm", the same verb as 12:10
decisions.reason: The meaning decision links the verb to 12:10; Vietnamese keeps one word for both.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵבֹ֧שׁוּ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנ֖וֹ בְּהִנָּֽבְאֹת֑וֹ וְלֹ֧א יִלְבְּשׁ֛וּ אַדֶּ֥רֶת שֵׂעָ֖ר לְמַ֥עַן כַּחֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] will be ashamed the prophets, each of his vision when he prophesies; and they will not put on a cloak of hair in order to deceive.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] the prophets will be ashamed, each of his vision when he prophesies; and they will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
en.B: On that day every prophet will be ashamed of the vision he prophesies, and they will not put on a prophet's hairy cloak to deceive people.
en.R: At that time the prophets will be ashamed of their visions and of what they say. They will no longer wear a prophet's coat made of hair to trick people.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] los profetas se avergonzarán, cada uno de su visión cuando profetice; y no se vestirán el manto de pelo para engañar.
es.B: Aquel día todo profeta se avergonzará de la visión que profetiza, y no se pondrán el manto de pelo de profeta para engañar a la gente.
es.R: En ese tiempo los profetas sentirán vergüenza de sus visiones y de lo que dicen. Ya no se pondrán la capa de pelo de los profetas para engañar a la gente.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] les prophètes auront honte, chacun de sa vision quand il prophétisera ; et ils ne revêtiront plus le manteau de poil pour tromper.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, chaque prophète aura honte de la vision qu’il annonce, et ils ne mettront plus le manteau de poil des prophètes pour tromper les gens.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, les prophètes auront honte de leurs visions et de ce qu’ils disent. Ils ne porteront plus le manteau en poils de prophète pour tromper les gens.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile [kwamba] manabii wataona aibu, kila mmoja kwa ajili ya maono yake anapotabiri; wala hawatavaa vazi la manyoya ili kudanganya.
sw.B: Siku hiyo kila nabii ataona aibu kwa ajili ya maono anayoyatabiri, wala hawatavaa vazi la manyoya la nabii ili kuwadanganya watu.
sw.R: Wakati huo manabii wataona aibu kwa ajili ya maono yao na yale wanayosema. Hawatavaa tena koti la nabii lililotengenezwa kwa manyoya ili kuwahadaa watu.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, các tiên tri sẽ hổ thẹn, mỗi người về khải tượng của mình khi nói tiên tri; và họ sẽ không mặc áo choàng lông để lừa gạt nữa.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, mỗi tiên tri sẽ hổ thẹn về khải tượng mình nói ra, và họ sẽ không mặc áo choàng lông của nhà tiên tri để lừa gạt người ta nữa.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, các tiên tri sẽ xấu hổ về những khải tượng và những lời họ nói. Họ sẽ không còn mặc áo khoác bằng lông của nhà tiên tri để lừa người ta nữa.

ko.L: 그날에 예언자들이 예언할 때에 저마다 자기 환상을 부끄러워할 것이고, 속이려고 털옷을 입지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 예언자들은 저마다 자기가 예언하는 환상을 부끄러워할 것이다. 그들은 사람들을 속이려고 예언자의 털옷을 입지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 예언자들은 자기들이 본 환상과 자기들이 하는 말을 부끄러워할 것이다. 그들은 더 이상 사람들을 속이려고 털로 만든 예언자의 옷을 입지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: a hairy cloak: the dress of a prophet
decisions.reason: Elijah was known by his hairy garment and leather belt (2 Kings 1:8), and his cloak passed to Elisha (1 Kings 19:19; 2 Kings 2:13-14). John the Baptist dressed the same way (Matthew 3:4). False prophets wore it to look like true ones. The word for cloak is the one translated "glory" in 11:3.

decisions.choice: the prophets will be ashamed, each of his vision: they will not want to be known as prophets
decisions.reason: On that day the false prophets will be ashamed of their visions and will hide that they ever were prophets, as verses 5-6 show.

decisions.choice: a prophet's hairy cloak (B); a prophet's coat made of hair (R); to deceive people (B); to trick people (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose cloak it was (m1) and whom the prophets deceive. Readable makes the visions plural, "their visions".

decisions.choice: "el manto de pelo" (L, B); "la capa de pelo" (R)
decisions.reason: The hairy cloak is the prophet's dress (as Elijah's); B and R say it belongs to prophets, as the English does.

source.text: וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי אִישׁ־עֹבֵ֤ד אֲדָמָה֙ אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אָדָ֖ם הִקְנַ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will say, Not a prophet [am] I; a man working [the] ground [am] I, for a man acquired me from my youth.

en.L: And he will say, "I [am] not a prophet; I [am] a man who works the ground, for a man bought me in my youth."
en.B: Each will say, "I am no prophet. I work the soil; I was sold to a man as a servant when I was young."
en.R: Each of them will say, "I am not a prophet. I am a farmer. Someone bought me as a servant when I was young, and I have worked the land ever since."

es.L: Y dirá: «No [soy] profeta; [soy] un hombre que trabaja la tierra, porque un hombre me compró desde mi juventud».
es.B: Cada uno dirá: «Yo no soy profeta. Trabajo la tierra; me vendieron a un hombre como siervo cuando era joven».
es.R: Cada uno de ellos dirá: «Yo no soy profeta. Soy agricultor. Alguien me compró como siervo cuando era joven, y desde entonces he trabajado la tierra».

fr.L: Et il dira : « Je ne [suis] pas prophète ; je [suis] un homme qui cultive la terre, car un homme m’a acheté dès ma jeunesse. »
fr.B: Chacun dira : « Je ne suis pas prophète. Je travaille la terre ; j’ai été vendu comme serviteur à un homme quand j’étais jeune. »
fr.R: Chacun d’eux dira : « Je ne suis pas prophète. Je suis cultivateur. Quelqu’un m’a acheté comme serviteur quand j’étais jeune, et depuis, je travaille la terre. »

sw.L: Naye atasema, "Mimi [si] nabii; mimi [ni] mtu anayelima ardhi, kwa maana mtu alininunua tangu ujana wangu."
sw.B: Kila mmoja atasema, "Mimi si nabii. Ninalima ardhi; niliuzwa kwa mtu kuwa mtumishi nilipokuwa kijana."
sw.R: Kila mmoja wao atasema, "Mimi si nabii. Mimi ni mkulima. Mtu fulani alininunua kuwa mtumishi nilipokuwa kijana, nami nimefanya kazi shambani tangu wakati huo."

vi.L: Người ấy sẽ nói: "Tôi không [phải là] tiên tri; tôi [là] người làm ruộng, vì một người đã mua tôi từ thuở thiếu thời."
vi.B: Ai nấy sẽ nói: "Tôi không phải là tiên tri. Tôi là người làm ruộng; từ nhỏ tôi đã bị bán cho một người làm đầy tớ."
vi.R: Mỗi người sẽ nói: "Tôi không phải là tiên tri. Tôi là nông dân. Có người đã mua tôi làm đầy tớ khi tôi còn nhỏ, và từ đó tôi làm ruộng."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말할 것이다. "나는 예언자가 아니오. 나는 땅을 일구는 사람이오. 어릴 때부터 어떤 사람이 나를 샀기 때문이오."
ko.B: 저마다 이렇게 말할 것이다. "나는 예언자가 아니오. 나는 농사꾼이오. 어릴 때에 남의 종으로 팔려 왔소."
ko.R: 그들은 저마다 이렇게 말할 것이다. "나는 예언자가 아니오. 나는 농부요. 어릴 때에 어떤 사람이 나를 종으로 사 갔고, 그때부터 나는 땅을 일구며 살았소."

decisions.choice: I am not a prophet: the words of Amos, used to deny the calling
decisions.reason: Amos told the priest of Bethel, "I am not a prophet, nor a member of a company of prophets; I am a herdsman" (Amos 7:14). Amos meant that the LORD had called him from his work. The false prophet uses the same words to hide what he had been.

decisions.choice: a man bought me in my youth: following the Hebrew text
alternatives: the land has been my possession since my youth
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "a man acquired me (as a servant) from my youth". He claims that he has always worked the land for a master, and so had no time to be a prophet. Some read the same letters as "the ground has been my possession from my youth", that is, "I have been a farmer all my life". The sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: Each will say (B); Each of them will say (R); as a servant (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "each" for the singular "he", since verse 4 speaks of every prophet, and add "as a servant" to explain "bought me" (m2).

decisions.choice: The former prophet and his questioner speak 하오체 ("나는 예언자가 아니오", "당신")
decisions.reason: Two adults speaking guardedly as equals; the line still echoes Amos 7:14 (meaning decision), where the Korean has 해라체 "나는 예언자가 아니다" in Amos's answer to Amaziah.

decisions.choice: "Je ne [suis] pas prophète" (L)
decisions.reason: The words of the published Amos 7:14, which the meaning decision notes.

decisions.choice: "No [soy] profeta" (L); "Yo no soy profeta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words are those of Amos 7:14 and are worded as the Spanish there at each level.

source.text: וְאָמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו מָ֧ה הַמַּכּ֛וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה בֵּ֣ין יָדֶ֑יךָ וְאָמַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכֵּ֖יתִי בֵּ֥ית מְאַהֲבָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [one] will say to him, What [are] the wounds these between your hands? And he will say, [Those with] which I was struck [at the] house of my friends.

en.L: And [someone] will say to him, "What [are] these wounds between your hands?" And he will say, "[Those] with which I was struck [in] the house of my friends."
en.B: And if someone asks him, "Then what are these wounds on your chest?" he will answer, "I got them in the house of my friends."
en.R: If someone asks him, "Then what are these wounds on your chest?" he will say, "I was hurt at my friends' house."

es.L: Y [alguien] le dirá: «¿Qué [son] estas heridas entre tus manos?». Y él dirá: «[Las] que recibí [en] la casa de mis amigos».
es.B: Y si alguien le pregunta: «Entonces, ¿qué son esas heridas que tienes en el pecho?», él responderá: «Me las hicieron en casa de mis amigos».
es.R: Si alguien le pregunta: «Entonces, ¿qué son esas heridas que tienes en el pecho?», él dirá: «Me lastimaron en casa de mis amigos».

fr.L: Et [quelqu’un] lui dira : « Qu’[est-ce que] ces blessures entre tes mains ? » Et il dira : « [Celles] dont j’ai été frappé [dans] la maison de mes amis. »
fr.B: Et si quelqu’un lui demande : « Alors, que sont ces blessures sur ta poitrine ? », il répondra : « Je les ai reçues dans la maison de mes amis. »
fr.R: Si quelqu’un lui demande : « Alors, qu’est-ce que ces blessures sur ta poitrine ? », il dira : « On m’a blessé chez mes amis. »

sw.L: Na [mtu] atamwambia, "Majeraha haya kati ya mikono yako [ni] nini?" Naye atasema, "[Ni yale] niliyopigwa [katika] nyumba ya rafiki zangu."
sw.B: Na mtu akimwuliza, "Basi majeraha haya kifuani pako ni nini?" atajibu, "Niliyapata nyumbani kwa rafiki zangu."
sw.R: Mtu akimwuliza, "Basi majeraha haya kifuani pako ni ya nini?" atasema, "Niliumizwa nyumbani kwa rafiki zangu."

vi.L: Rồi [có người] sẽ hỏi người ấy: "Những vết thương giữa hai tay anh [là] gì vậy?" Người ấy sẽ đáp: "[Đó là những vết] tôi bị đánh [tại] nhà của bạn bè tôi."
vi.B: Nếu có ai hỏi: "Vậy những vết thương trên ngực anh là gì?" thì người ấy sẽ đáp: "Tôi bị thương tại nhà bạn bè tôi."
vi.R: Nếu có ai hỏi: "Vậy những vết thương trên ngực anh là gì?" thì người ấy sẽ nói: "Tôi bị thương ở nhà bạn bè tôi."

ko.L: 누가 그에게 "당신 두 손 사이에 있는 이 상처들은 무엇이오?" 하고 물으면, 그가 "내 친구들의 집에서 맞은 [상처들이오]" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 누가 그에게 "그러면 당신 가슴에 있는 이 상처들은 무엇이오?" 하고 물으면, 그는 "내 친구들의 집에서 얻은 것이오" 하고 대답할 것이다.
ko.R: 누가 그에게 "그러면 당신 가슴에 있는 이 상처들은 다 뭐요?" 하고 물으면, 그는 "친구 집에서 다쳤소" 하고 말할 것이다.

decisions.choice: wounds between your hands: wounds on the chest or back
decisions.reason: "Between the hands" means the body between the arms, the chest or the back (2 Kings 9:24 uses the phrase of an arrow that struck the king between his shoulders). Prophets of Baal cut themselves in their frenzy (1 Kings 18:28), and the law forbade such cutting (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 14:1). The scars would give away that the man had been such a prophet.

decisions.choice: in the house of my friends: an excuse, perhaps a pun
decisions.reason: The man explains his scars as wounds from a quarrel among friends. The word for "friends" means "those who love me", and the prophets use it of the lovers Israel ran after, its false gods (Hosea 2:7; Jeremiah 22:20), so the excuse may give away the truth.

decisions.choice: the wounds of a false prophet, not a prophecy of Christ
decisions.reason: Older translations read "wounds in your hands", and some Christian readers took the verse as a prophecy of the wounds of Christ. In its setting the speaker is a false prophet who denies what he has been (verses 4-5), and his wounds are on his body, not his hands. The New Testament does not quote this verse. The next verse turns to the LORD's shepherd.

decisions.choice: on your chest (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "between your hands" (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "entre tus manos" (L); "en el pecho" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means wounds on the chest or back; L keeps it and B and R give the sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "가슴" (B, R); "두 손 사이" (L)
decisions.reason: "Between your hands" means the chest or back (meaning decision); the wounds belong to a false prophet, not to Christ, and Korean does not phrase them like the Gospels' wounds in the hands.

source.text: חֶ֗רֶב עוּרִ֤י עַל־רֹעִי֙ וְעַל־גֶּ֣בֶר עֲמִיתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת הַ֤ךְ אֶת־הָֽרֹעֶה֙ וּתְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַצֹּ֔אן וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י יָדִ֖י עַל־הַצֹּעֲרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Sword, awake against my shepherd, and against [the] man [who is] my associate, declaration of Yahweh of hosts. Strike the shepherd, and will be scattered the sheep; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

en.L: Sword, awake against {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} shepherd, and against the man [who is] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} associate, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts. \q Strike the shepherd, and let the sheep be scattered; \q and I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand upon the small ones.
en.B: Awake, sword, against {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} shepherd, against the man who stands next to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will scatter; \q I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against even the little ones.
en.R: Sword, wake up and attack {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} shepherd, the man who is close to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Kill the shepherd, and the sheep will run off in every direction. \q I will turn against even the weakest of the flock.

es.L: Espada, despierta contra {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pastor, y contra el hombre [que es] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} compañero, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos. \q Golpea al pastor, y que se dispersen las ovejas; \q y volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra los pequeños.
es.B: Despierta, espada, contra {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pastor, contra el hombre que está a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lado, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Golpea al pastor, y que se dispersen las ovejas; \q volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano aun contra los pequeños.
es.R: Espada, despierta y ataca a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pastor, al hombre que está cerca de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Mata al pastor, y las ovejas huirán en todas direcciones. \q Me volveré aun contra las más débiles del rebaño.

fr.L: Épée, réveille-toi contre {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} berger, et contre l’homme [qui est] {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} compagnon, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Frappe le berger, et que les brebis soient dispersées ; \q et je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main sur les petits.
fr.B: Debout, épée, contre {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} berger, contre l’homme qui se tient à côté de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Frappe le berger, et les brebis seront dispersées ; \q je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main même contre les petits.
fr.R: Épée, réveille-toi, attaque {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} berger, l’homme qui est proche de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Tue le berger, et les moutons s’enfuiront de tous côtés. \q Je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tournerai même contre les plus faibles du troupeau.

sw.L: Ee upanga, amka dhidi ya mchungaji {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na dhidi ya mtu [aliye] mwenzi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Mpige mchungaji, na kondoo watawanyike; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya wadogo.
sw.B: Amka, ee upanga, dhidi ya mchungaji {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, dhidi ya mtu anayesimama karibu {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Mpige mchungaji, nao kondoo watatawanyika; \q nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hata dhidi ya wadogo.
sw.R: Ee upanga, amka umshambulie mchungaji {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, mtu aliye karibu {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Muue mchungaji, nao kondoo watakimbia pande zote. \q Nitawageukia hata walio dhaifu kuliko wote katika kundi.

vi.L: Hỡi gươm, hãy thức dậy nghịch cùng người chăn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và nghịch cùng người [là] bạn đồng hành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. \q Hãy đánh người chăn, thì chiên sẽ tan lạc; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở tay nghịch cùng những con nhỏ.
vi.B: Hỡi gươm, hãy thức dậy nghịch cùng người chăn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nghịch cùng người đứng cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy. \q Hãy đánh người chăn, thì chiên sẽ tan lạc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở tay nghịch cùng cả những con nhỏ.
vi.R: Hỡi gươm, hãy thức dậy và tấn công người chăn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là người gần gũi với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Hãy giết người chăn, thì đàn chiên sẽ chạy tán loạn khắp nơi. \q Ta sẽ trở tay nghịch cùng cả những con yếu nhất trong bầy.

ko.L: 칼아, 깨어나 내 목자를 쳐라. 내 동료인 사람을 쳐라. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 목자를 쳐라. 그러면 양들이 흩어질 것이다. \q 내가 작은 것들 위로 내 손을 돌리겠다.
ko.B: 칼아, 깨어나 내 목자를, 내 곁에 서 있는 사람을 쳐라. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 목자를 쳐라. 그러면 양들이 흩어질 것이다. \q 나는 어린 것들에게까지 손을 대겠다.
ko.R: 칼아, 깨어나서 내 목자를, 나와 가까운 그 사람을 쳐라. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 목자를 죽여라. 그러면 양들이 사방으로 흩어질 것이다. \q 나는 양 떼 가운데 가장 약한 것들까지 치겠다.

decisions.choice: Sword, awake against my shepherd: the LORD himself calls for his shepherd to be struck
decisions.reason: The LORD calls on the sword as if it were a person, as in Jeremiah 47:6. The shepherd is "my shepherd", one the LORD appointed. The verses do not say who he is. Many read him as the good shepherd rejected in 11:4-14, whom the people valued at thirty pieces of silver; some take him as the worthless shepherd of 11:17, and some move verses 7-9 to follow 11:17. "The man who is my associate" fits a shepherd close to the LORD better than a worthless one.

decisions.choice: the man who is my associate: one who stands beside the LORD as a near companion
decisions.reason: The word is rare. It is used in Leviticus for one's fellow or neighbor, a near equal (Leviticus 5:21; 19:11, 15; 25:14-17). Here it is the LORD who calls the shepherd his "associate", a man closely bound to him.

decisions.choice: I will turn my hand against the little ones: judgment that falls on the weak of the flock too
decisions.reason: To turn one's hand against someone is to act against them (Amos 1:8). The "little ones" are the young and weak of the flock (Jeremiah 49:20). When the shepherd is struck, the flock suffers too; verses 8-9 show that the judgment also refines a remnant. Isaiah 1:25 uses the same phrase for the LORD's purifying of his people.

decisions.choice: Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered: quoted by Jesus in Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27
decisions.reason: On the night of his arrest Jesus quotes these words of himself and his disciples, who will all leave him. In the Gospels' wording God himself says "I will strike the shepherd". In the Hebrew the LORD commands the sword to strike, so in both he is the one behind the striking.

decisions.choice: my shepherd, my associate, my hand (deity_pronoun setting); the shepherd (no setting)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks of himself, so "my", "me" and "my hand" take the deity_pronoun setting. The shepherd takes none, as the pierced one of 12:10 and the king of 9:9 do not: the text does not settle who he is (m1).

decisions.choice: the man who stands next to me (B); the man who is close to me (R); Kill (R); run off in every direction (R); against even the weakest of the flock (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain "associate" (m2). Readable says "Kill" for "Strike", as the sword strikes to kill, and explains "the little ones" (m3). "Declares the LORD of hosts" follows the wording set in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "Golpea al pastor, y que se dispersen las ovejas" (L, B); "Mata al pastor, y las ovejas huirán en todas direcciones" (R)
decisions.reason: The line keeps the key words of Matthew 26:31 in Spanish ("pastor", "ovejas", "se dispersarán" / "huirán en todas direcciones") so the quotation can be seen; the Hebrew is a command to the sword ("Strike"), where the Gospel's Greek has "I will strike".

decisions.choice: "Frappe le berger", "les brebis seront dispersées" (L, B), "les moutons s'enfuiront de tous côtés" (R)
decisions.reason: The key words of the published Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27 at each level, as the term sheet asks; Zechariah has the imperative "Strike", where the Gospels' Greek has "I will strike".

decisions.choice: "Mpige mchungaji, na kondoo watawanyike" (L); "... nao kondoo watatawanyika" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is a command to the sword. Jesus' quotation in the published Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27 reads "Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo watatawanywa", following the Greek first person; Swahili keeps "mchungaji", "kondoo" and the verb of scattering so the link can be seen.

decisions.choice: "Hãy đánh người chăn, thì chiên sẽ tan lạc" (L, B), as Matthew 26:31
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, close to Matthew 26:31 so the quotation is visible; the Hebrew is a command to the sword, where Matthew (from the Greek) has "I will strike". The shepherd is "người", lowercase, with no deity span.

decisions.choice: "목자를 쳐라. 그러면 양들이 흩어질 것이다" (L, B)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: Matthew 26:31 and Mark 14:27 quote the line as "내가 목자를 칠 것이니", with the future from the Greek; the Hebrew imperative is kept here, and the rest of the line matches. The shepherd takes no -시-, as the English has no deity span for him.

decisions.choice: "karibu nami", with the span on the joined pronoun "nami"
decisions.reason: Swahili style guide 7: the joined form "nami" is a free pronoun and takes the span when it means God.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה בְכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה פִּֽי־שְׁנַ֣יִם בָּ֔הּ יִכָּרְת֖וּ יִגְוָ֑עוּ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית יִוָּ֥תֶר בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in all the land, declaration of Yahweh, [that] two portions in it will be cut off [and] perish, and the third will be left in it.

en.L: And it will be in all the land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [that] two parts in it will be cut off [and] perish, \q and the third will be left in it.
en.B: In the whole land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q two-thirds will be cut off and die, \q but one-third will be left in it.
en.R: In the whole land, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q two out of every three people will be killed, \q and only one out of three will be left alive.

es.L: Y sucederá en toda la tierra, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q [que] dos partes en ella serán cortadas [y] perecerán, \q y la tercera quedará en ella.
es.B: En toda la tierra, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q dos terceras partes serán exterminadas y morirán, \q pero una tercera parte quedará en ella.
es.R: En todo el país, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q dos de cada tres personas morirán, \q y solo una de cada tres quedará con vida.

fr.L: Et il arrivera dans tout le pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q [que] deux parts y seront retranchées [et] périront, \q et le tiers y sera laissé.
fr.B: Dans tout le pays, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q les deux tiers seront retranchés et mourront, \q mais un tiers y restera.
fr.R: Dans tout le pays, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q deux personnes sur trois seront tuées, \q et une seule sur trois restera en vie.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika nchi yote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q [kwamba] sehemu mbili ndani yake zitakatiliwa mbali [na] kuangamia, \q na ya tatu itabaki ndani yake.
sw.B: Katika nchi yote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q theluthi mbili zitakatiliwa mbali na kufa, \q lakini theluthi moja itabaki ndani yake.
sw.R: Katika nchi yote, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q watu wawili kati ya kila watatu watauawa, \q na mmoja tu kati ya watatu ndiye atakayebaki hai.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong khắp xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q hai phần trong đó sẽ bị diệt trừ [và] chết, \q còn một phần ba sẽ được để lại trong đó.
vi.B: Trong khắp xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q hai phần ba sẽ bị diệt trừ và chết, \q nhưng một phần ba sẽ còn lại trong đó.
vi.R: Trong khắp xứ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q cứ ba người thì hai người sẽ bị giết, \q và chỉ một người sẽ còn sống sót.

ko.L: 온 땅에서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다, \q 그 가운데 삼분의 이는 끊어져 죽고, \q 삼분의 일은 거기에 남을 것이다.
ko.B: 온 땅에서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다, \q 삼분의 이가 끊어져 죽고, \q 삼분의 일만 거기에 남을 것이다.
ko.R: 온 땅에서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다, \q 세 사람 가운데 두 사람이 죽임을 당하고, \q 세 사람 가운데 한 사람만 살아남을 것이다.

decisions.choice: two parts: two-thirds
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "a mouth of two", an idiom for a double share or two portions (Deuteronomy 21:17; 2 Kings 2:9). With "the third" that follows, it means two of three parts.

decisions.choice: two-thirds cut off, one-third left: a remnant survives the judgment
decisions.reason: Ezekiel 5:1-12 divides the people into thirds, with only a few saved. Here the third that is left becomes the purified people of verse 9. The numbers stress how severe the judgment is, and that a remnant remains.

decisions.choice: two parts ... the third (L); two-thirds ... one-third (B); two out of every three ... one out of three (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "two parts"; Balanced and Readable give the fractions (m1). "Declares the LORD" follows the wording set in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" and "…가 말한다" kept inside the first line
decisions.reason: In this poetic line the formula stands between the setting and the sentence, as in the Hebrew and the English; Korean marks it off with commas.

source.text: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶת־הַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּצְרַפְתִּים֙ כִּצְרֹ֣ף אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְחַנְתִּ֖ים כִּבְחֹ֣ן אֶת־הַזָּהָ֑ב ה֣וּא׀יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֗י וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶעֱנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ עַמִּ֣י ה֔וּא וְה֥וּא יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring the third into the fire, and I will refine them as one refines the silver, and I will test them as one tests the gold. It will call on my name, and I will answer it; I will say, My people [is] it; and it will say, Yahweh [is] my God.

en.L: And I will bring the third into the fire, \q and refine them as one refines silver, \q and test them as one tests gold. \q It will call on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and I will answer it; \q I will say, "My people [is] it," \q and it will say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] my God."
en.B: I will bring this third through the fire; \q I will refine them as silver is refined \q and test them as one tests gold. \q They will call on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and I will answer. \q I will say, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people," \q and they will say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my God."
en.R: I will put the third that is left through the fire. \q I will make them pure, as silver is made pure, \q and test them, as gold is tested. \q They will pray to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will answer them. \q I will say, "These are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people." \q And each of them will say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my God."

es.L: Y meteré la tercera parte en el fuego, \q y los refinaré como se refina la plata, \q y los probaré como se prueba el oro. \q Él invocará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y yo le responderé; \q diré: «Pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} [es] él», \q y él dirá: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] mi Dios».
es.B: Haré pasar por el fuego a esta tercera parte; \q la refinaré como se refina la plata \q y la probaré como se prueba el oro. \q Invocarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y yo les responderé. \q Diré: «Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo», \q y ellos dirán: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi Dios».
es.R: Haré pasar por el fuego a los que queden. \q Los purificaré como se purifica la plata, \q y los probaré como se prueba el oro. \q Me pedirán ayuda, y yo les responderé. \q Diré: «Ellos son {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo». \q Y cada uno de ellos dirá: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi Dios».

fr.L: Et je ferai entrer le tiers dans le feu, \q et je les épurerai comme on épure l’argent, \q et je les éprouverai comme on éprouve l’or. \q Il invoquera {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je lui répondrai ; \q je dirai : « Mon peuple, [c’est] lui », \q et il dira : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] mon Dieu. »
fr.B: Je ferai passer ce tiers par le feu ; \q je l’épurerai comme on épure l’argent \q et je l’éprouverai comme on éprouve l’or. \q Il invoquera {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et je lui répondrai. \q Je dirai : « C’est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple », \q et il dira : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est mon Dieu. »
fr.R: Je ferai passer par le feu le tiers qui reste. \q Je les rendrai purs, comme on rend l’argent pur, \q et je les mettrai à l’épreuve, comme on éprouve l’or. \q Ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} prieront, et je leur répondrai. \q Je dirai : « C’est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. » \q Et chacun d’eux dira : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est mon Dieu. »

sw.L: Nami nitaileta theluthi hiyo motoni, \q na kuwasafisha kama mtu asafishavyo fedha, \q na kuwajaribu kama mtu ajaribuvyo dhahabu. \q Itaiitia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaijibu; \q nitasema, "Hao [ni] watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}," \q nayo itasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] Mungu wangu."
sw.B: Nitaipitisha theluthi hii motoni; \q nitawasafisha kama fedha isafishwavyo \q na kuwajaribu kama mtu ajaribuvyo dhahabu. \q Watakiitia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu. \q Nitasema, "Hawa ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}," \q nao watasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu wangu."
sw.R: Nitawapitisha motoni wale theluthi moja waliobaki. \q Nitawafanya safi, kama fedha inavyofanywa safi, \q na kuwajaribu, kama dhahabu inavyojaribiwa. \q Wataniomba, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu. \q Nitasema, "Hawa ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}." \q Na kila mmoja wao atasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu wangu."

vi.L: Ta sẽ đem một phần ba ấy vào lửa, \q luyện họ như người ta luyện bạc, \q và thử họ như người ta thử vàng. \q Nó sẽ kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời nó; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phán: "Nó [là] dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," \q và nó sẽ nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời của tôi."
vi.B: Ta sẽ đưa một phần ba ấy qua lửa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ luyện họ như luyện bạc \q và thử họ như thử vàng. \q Họ sẽ kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời. \q Ta sẽ phán: "Đây là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}," \q và họ sẽ nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi."
vi.R: Ta sẽ đưa một phần ba còn lại ấy qua lửa. \q Ta sẽ làm cho họ tinh sạch như bạc được luyện, \q và thử họ như vàng được thử. \q Họ sẽ cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời họ. \q Ta sẽ phán: "Đây là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}." \q Và mỗi người trong họ sẽ nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi."

ko.L: 내가 그 삼분의 일을 불 속에 넣어, \q 은을 단련하듯 그들을 단련하고, \q 금을 시험하듯 그들을 시험하겠다. \q 그들이 내 이름을 부르면 내가 그들에게 응답하겠다. \q 내가 "그들은 내 백성이다" 하고 말하면, \q 그들은 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 하나님이시다" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 이 삼분의 일을 불 속으로 지나가게 하여, \q 은을 정련하듯 그들을 정련하고, \q 금을 시험하듯 그들을 시험하겠다. \q 그들이 내 이름을 부르면 내가 응답하겠다. \q 내가 "이들은 내 백성이다" 하고 말하면, \q 그들은 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 하나님이시다" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 살아남은 삼분의 일을 불 속으로 지나가게 하겠다. \q 은을 깨끗하게 하듯 그들을 깨끗하게 하고, \q 금을 시험하듯 그들을 시험하겠다. \q 그들이 나에게 기도하면, 내가 그들에게 대답하겠다. \q 나는 "이들은 내 백성이다" 하고 말할 것이다. \q 그러면 그들은 저마다 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 하나님이시다" 하고 말할 것이다.

decisions.choice: refine them as silver, test them as gold: the fire purifies
decisions.reason: Silver and gold were melted in a furnace so that the waste rose to the top and could be removed, leaving the pure metal (Proverbs 17:3). The prophets use the picture of God purifying his people through suffering (Isaiah 1:25; 48:10; Malachi 3:2-3; Psalm 66:10). 1 Peter 1:7 uses it of faith tested by trials.

decisions.choice: They are my people ... The LORD is my God: the covenant words spoken again
decisions.reason: These are the words of the covenant between the LORD and Israel (Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 31:33). Hosea 1:9 had denied them, and Hosea 2:25 restored them in the same exchange: "You are my people", "My God". The purified remnant is the covenant people again.

decisions.choice: it will call ... it will say: the remnant spoken of as one
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of "the third" as one person: "it will call", "I will answer it", "my people is it", "it will say, my God". The remnant speaks as one, and the last words, "my God", are each one's confession.

decisions.choice: call on my name (L, B); pray to me (R); my God; each of them (R)
decisions.reason: "Call on the name" of the LORD is to pray to him and worship him (Genesis 4:26; Joel 3:5); Readable says "pray to me". The LORD speaks of his own name and people, so "my" and "me" take the deity_pronoun setting; "my God" is the people's word and takes none. Literal keeps the Hebrew singular, "it"; Balanced and Readable say "they" and "these", and Readable adds "each of them" to explain "my" (m3).

decisions.choice: "Pueblo mío [es] él" (L); "Este es mi pueblo" (B); "Ellos son mi pueblo" (R); "El SEÑOR es mi Dios"
decisions.reason: The covenant words are spoken again; L keeps the Hebrew singular for the remnant ("él"), and B and R follow the English. The people's own "my God" takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "그들은 내 백성이다" … "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 나의 하나님이시다"
decisions.reason: The covenant words of 8:8 again (meaning decision); the remnant, spoken of as one in the Hebrew, is "그들" in Korean, and they speak of God with the honorific. "는" reads after both forms of the span.

decisions.choice: "nó" (L) for the remnant spoken of as one, "họ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: L keeps the Hebrew singular; B and R use "họ", the term sheet's pronoun for Israel in promises.

decisions.choice: "il invoquera ... je lui répondrai ... il dira" (L, B), singular
decisions.reason: The remnant is spoken of as one in Hebrew (the meaning decision); French "le tiers" is singular, so B keeps it where the English Balanced says "they"; Readable says "ils".

decisions.choice: "Mon peuple, [c'est] lui" (L)
decisions.reason: Keeps the Hebrew order, with the predicate first, as the English Literal.

decisions.choice: "Itaiitia ... nitaijibu ... nayo itasema" (L), agreeing with "theluthi"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of the remnant as one ("it"); Literal lets the verbs agree with "theluthi" (class 9). Balanced and Readable use the plural, as the English.
